title: daoWare
tagline: No code MVP Application to generate a DAO + Deploy website to IPFS
description: The tools to quickly create DAOs and their related infrastructure are here, and you shouldn't need to know how to code to create them. This project is an application to deploy a DAO + dao website onto Polygon and IPFS all from one easy UI. Future work for this project will include cleaning up UIs, making DAO more advanced, and also creating more tools like a discord integration token bot and much more.
how_its_made: Projects uses a react front end demo app, nodejs backend to construct a website template, and then uses polygon to deploy erc20 + textile apis to upload website. Polygon was super nice to work with because I could literally test in prod very cheaply! Textile is also extremely useful because I barely need to know about the intricacies of storage deals and filecoin.
